text: Place a glass of water beside your bed tonight. Tomorrow morning you will understand why. Before you sleep, fill a clear glass with water. Hold it with both hands.
Say quietly: absorb what is heavy, remove what is not mine. Then sleep. In the morning, look at it before you speak to anyone. Three things can happen.
First, small bubbles cling to the inside of the glass. The room was working hard. This is the most common. Second, the water is cloudy. That weight is older, months you never put down.
Third, it is still clear. Your space is light. Not all exhaustion comes from the body, my friend. You are not lazy, and you are not weak.
You have been sleeping beside something you could not see. A glass of water shows you the weight.
It cannot take it off you. Forty years taught me to live without it.
Everything I know is inside The Quiet Between Thoughts. The link is in my profile.
